About.title: A small team digitizing the appointment book
About.intro: HopperLine exists so that hair salons, beauty salons, and clinics in Turkey don't have to answer every WhatsApp and Instagram message by hand. We're a small, focused team right now — not a large company, but a group that saw this problem firsthand and set out to fix it.
About.originBody: HopperLine comes from two things: Grace Hopper, one of computer science's pioneers, and "front line" — the first point of contact. Whoever takes the booking is usually a business's first impression. HopperLine exists to make sure that impression is never missed.
About.visionBody: We want to become an operating system for appointment-based businesses — messaging, bookings, customer management, campaigns, and analytics in one dashboard. The Shopify for beauty salons. That's a direction, not a claim about our size today.
About.whyNowBody: WhatsApp and Instagram are now where most booking requests arrive. But the tools built to manage those messages either watch a single platform or require an enterprise sales process. HopperLine fills the self-serve gap in between.

Research.title: Why an AI receptionist is needed
Research.intro: This page summarizes the market observations we made before and while building HopperLine. It isn't a formal academic study — it's drawn from conversations with salon, hair studio, and clinic owners, plus a review of competing tools.
Research.tableNote: As of August 2026, based on publicly available information. This space moves quickly.
Research.gapBody: Tools that watch WhatsApp are usually single-channel and stop at template messages rather than real automation. Tools that also cover Instagram and use real AI tend to require an enterprise sales process or get sold as an agency project. We couldn't find one tool that combines WhatsApp, Instagram, and real-time appointment management in a single dashboard you can set up yourself.
Research.meaningTitle: What this means for a salon owner
Research.meaningBody: You don't need to switch between a separate WhatsApp tool, a separate Instagram solution, and a separate appointment calendar. Wherever the message comes from, the same AI reads it and books it onto the same calendar.
